research_rationale: Read ORIGINAL:EO:13080, its TERM record, ACTOR_TEXT:EO:13093 and ACTOR_TEXT:EO:13225 in full, all located actor provisions, the earlier chain, conflicts and search scope. Section 4 requires Committee termination no later than two years from the printed 1998-04-07 date, an outer limit of 2000-04-07. EO:13093 solely changes ten to up to20 in the second sentence of section 2(a); it is neither a whole-order end nor a Committee extension. Section 2(a) combines a Committee recommendation command with a separate Presidential designation instruction. The latter is a finite task based on nominations, not express continuing appointing authority. Reading it as Committee-dependent may yield the sunset; reading it as separately exhausted requires actual designation performance evidence, absent here. EO:13225 section 3(b) confirms prior Committee termination and completed work, but supplies no date. Section 5 makes formal revocation effective 2001-09-30, not signing 2001-09-28. Keeping a possibly completed designation instruction alive to formal revocation would be unsupported. This is a concrete original-command/performance ambiguity, not a hypothetical unidentified non-EO extension concern. No conflicts or extension leads are listed. Bounded machine search scope was read but does not supply the missing event fact. Retained designations may be accrued effects; that does not establish an unperformed continuing command. unresolved_material_gaps: Section 2(a) separately directs the President to designate rivers from Committee recommendations. EO:13093 changes ten to up to20 without extending the Committee or abolishing the instruction. EO:13225 confirms completed work but supplies no actual designation/completion date. The held wording does not sufficiently resolve whether the finite Presidential instruction expires with Committee termination or ceases on actual performance. Its exact first cessation is therefore unestablished; later formal revocation cannot substitute for an earlier actual performance date.
